## Set Up


```{r}
Study1 <- read.csv("Study1_data-1.csv")
Study2 <- read.csv("Study2_data-1.csv")
Study3 <- read.csv("Study3_data.csv")
library(tidyverse)
```


## Figure 2 and Figure 3

### Figure 2 
This figure shows the percentage of each response to the question asking participants whether they believe in moral progress across the 3 studies.

```{r}
bind_rows(
Study1 |> mutate(study="Study1"),
Study2 |> mutate(study="Study2"),
Study3 |> mutate(study="Study3")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=study, fill = progress.belief)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill") +
  labs(x = "Percentage", y =  NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = c("0","25","50","75","100"))
```


### Figure 3

```{r}
bind_rows(
Study1 |> mutate(study="Study1"),
Study2 |> mutate(study="Study2"),
Study3 |> mutate(study="Study3")) |>
  ggplot(aes(y=Human))
```
